basics.name: Ali Rzayev
basics.title: Frontend Team Lead
basics.summary: Frontend Team Lead with 8+ years of experience building products from zero to production and scaling teams to maintain them. Led cross-functional teams of up to 5 engineers, shipped SaaS products from MVP to market, and drove large-scale legacy-to-modern refactors serving 13,000+ customers. Hands-on technical leader who pairs roadmap ownership with deep frontend expertise.

highlights: Collaborated with CTO and CPO to define product roadmap and led the frontend team in executing it across 6 products - POS system, admin dashboard, QR menu, payment gateway, partner portal, and marketing website
Managed senior and mid-level developers - code reviews, deployments, task delegation, and sprint planning
Eliminated all legacy bug tickets and reduced incoming bug reports to near-zero while the customer base continued to scale
Drove resolution of accumulated tech debt, stabilizing the product suite for a growing active user base
Led full refactor of a WordPress plugin serving 13,000+ customers from legacy jQuery/MVC/PHP to React, Vite, Module SCSS, and REST API architecture
Built a plugin extension system from scratch, enabling modular feature development and third-party integrations with 20+ APIs
Created custom rich text editor plugins for functionality not available in existing libraries
Shipped the refactored product to production in 4-5 months while maintaining the legacy version in parallel
Mentored 1 junior and 2 mid-level engineers through code reviews, documentation standards, and Git branching strategy
Managed collaboration between Product Owner and engineering team, translating product requirements into technical tasks
Planned sprints, authored and maintained documentation on Wiki/Confluence, and resolved cross-team blockers
Mentored junior and mid-level developers on engineering best practices
Automated deployment pipelines using GitLab CI, reducing manual release overhead

Built Planly - a social media automation SaaS - from concept to production: assembled a team of 4 engineers (1 senior, 3 mid), co-owned the product roadmap with PO, and shipped a production-ready MVP in under 5 months
Chose and implemented the technical architecture for Planly: React with modular CSS on the frontend, C# and Go on the backend
Led both frontend and backend teams, performing code reviews across 2+ languages and managing deployments for 13,000+ plugin customers
Built custom ORM, Query Builder, and deployment pipeline for the FS Poster WordPress plugin, ensuring compatibility across diverse server configurations
Containerized build processes and managed releases to a customer base of 13,000+
Built e-commerce platforms with product scraping from Trendyol, Amazon, and AliExpress
Delivered full-stack solutions using PHP, Python, Node.js on the backend and JavaScript/React on the frontend
